records.ptx_feature: PTX ISA 8.1 minimum; CUDA 13.3 emits PTX 9.3

stages.representation: pure inline PTX with a single packed source operand
stages.detail: CUDA 13.3 libNVVM compiled the 1,774-byte NVVM IR fixture (SHA-256 177071f5289fef1bade95e29f12afa689c91dc8f4c6f4d89cca810527c1317da) to 1,628-byte PTX (SHA-256 54595aa338e74747cf5ec117a0570f112c673a3d0266b7d2a5d850d3ba6c8ba4) and 2,268-byte LTOIR (SHA-256 dae644d035c13e6afec18e39d26ba16c8326caecab2d6425158b563d3d91a4ba). All eight forms retained their single packed source operand.

stages.representation: libNVVM-emitted f16x2 and packed-FP8 PTX
stages.detail: CUDA 13.3 ptxas accepted all eight forms at sm_89 and produced a 3,624-byte cubin (SHA-256 c761f544931d83935d10c7965037bad1536fd8d1f30cea4ae52f3826b4e8821e). The same PTX emitted for compute_87 was rejected with "Feature 'cvt.e4m3x2.f16x2' requires .target sm_89 or higher".

stages.representation: libNVVM LTOIR retaining all eight f16x2 and packed-FP8 conversions
stages.detail: CUDA 13.3 nvJitLink produced a 1,464-byte cubin (SHA-256 aadc245b2a8c0d63d2a3d5337bff8cb7c778022514b8f32d1e1efd61bf91ac3f) from the sm_89 LTOIR. Linking that same LTOIR for sm_87 failed with 'LTOIR arch newer than target arch'.
